text: 住房城乡建设部党组召开党组（扩大）会议。会议强调，多出惠民之策，多做民生实事，高质量开展城市更新和乡村人居环境改善，推动房地产高质量发展，加快建筑业提质升级，系统推进好房子、好小区、好社区、好城区“四好”建设，建设创新、宜居、美丽、韧性、文明、智慧的现代化人民城市，不断增强人民群众的获得感、幸福感、安全感。（中国建设报）
text_en: The Party Leadership Group of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development held an expanded meeting. The meeting stressed the need to introduce more policies benefiting the people, do more practical things for livelihoods, carry out high-quality urban renewal and rural living environment improvement, promote high-quality development of real estate, accelerate the upgrading of the construction industry, and systematically advance the building of good houses, good communities, good neighborhoods and good urban areas, building innovative, livable, beautiful, resilient, civilized and smart modern people's cities and continuously enhancing the people's sense of gain, happiness and security. (China Construction News)
